prompt: Gareth brought me two (jar) of sweet honey from his village.
explanation_ru: Мёд (honey) неисчисляемый, но его считают банками; после числительного two слово jar стоит во множественном числе — jars.

prompt: Is there (some / any) cold milk left for our morning coffee?
explanation_ru: В обычном вопросе о наличии неисчисляемого продукта (milk) используется any, а не some.

prompt: Nadia poured herself a tall (glass / bowl) of cold apple juice.
explanation_ru: Напитки (apple juice) считают стаканами — a glass of juice, а не мисками (bowl).

prompt: Tell me how (much / many) pupils are going on the coach trip.
explanation_ru: Существительное pupils исчисляемое и стоит во множественном числе, поэтому нужно выбрать how many.

prompt: Owen put on ___ clean blue jeans before meeting his cousins.
explanation_ru: Слово jeans употребляется только во множественном числе и сочетается с a pair of; неопределённый артикль a или one здесь ошибочны.

prompt: This week's maths homework (is / are) much harder than usual.
explanation_ru: Существительное homework неисчисляемое, поэтому глагол-связка стоит в единственном числе — is.

prompt: Daria opened ___ baked beans because she came home very late.
explanation_ru: В британском английском консервированную фасоль продают в банках — a tin of baked beans.

prompt: I can't buy those boots because they cost too many money.
answer: I can't buy those boots because they cost too much money.
accepted_answers: I can't buy those boots because they cost too much money.
I cannot buy those boots because they cost too much money.
explanation_ru: В английском money — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому с ним используется too much, а не many (типичная калька с русского «много денег»).

prompt: Could someone bring four thick (sheet) of white paper for our poster design?
explanation_ru: Бумагу (paper) считают листами; после числительного four исчисляемое слово sheet принимает форму множественного числа sheets.

prompt: Everyone in our street had ___ at the summer barbecue despite the light rain.
explanation_ru: Слово fun неисчисляемое, поэтому перед ним нельзя ставить артикль a, many или окончание -s; верный вариант — a lot of fun.

prompt: Tariq fetched three (pair) of sharp scissors from the cupboard so we could wrap the parcels.
explanation_ru: Парные предметы вроде scissors считают с помощью слова pair, которое после three стоит во множественном числе — pairs.

prompt: That strange news about the closed motorway (has / have) been on the local radio all morning.
explanation_ru: Несмотря на окончание -s, существительное news неисчисляемое и всегда согласуется с глаголом единственного числа (has).

prompt: "Good afternoon, could I have a thick (slice / bottle) of that farmhouse cheese, please?" "Of course, would you like (some / any) olives with that?" "No thanks, I don't need anything else today." The assistant wrapped the cheese neatly and handed over the receipt.
explanation_ru: Ломтик сыра обозначается выражением a slice of cheese, а в вежливом предложении (would you like...) принято использовать some.

prompt: Listen, let me give you an advice before you sign up for that gym.
answer: Listen, let me give you some advice before you sign up for that gym.
accepted_answers: Listen, let me give you some advice before you sign up for that gym.
Listen, let me give you a piece of advice before you sign up for that gym.
Listen, let me give you a bit of advice before you sign up for that gym.
explanation_ru: Слово advice неисчисляемое, поэтому артикль an перед ним — частая ошибка; правильно сказать some advice или a piece of advice.

prompt: A clothing shop has a weekend offer: if you pay £40, you walk out with two denim items for your legs. Which sign is grammatically correct?
options: Buy two jeans for £40 this weekend only!
Get two pieces of jeans for just £40!
Take home two jean for the price of one!
Two pairs of jeans for the price of one!
explanation_ru: С существительным jeans, которое всегда стоит во множественном числе, для счёта используется слово pairs: two pairs of jeans.

prompt: Nowadays, there are too (much / many) delivery vans and too (few / little) parking space near the station.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным vans во множественном числе используется too many, а с неисчисляемым space — too little.

prompt: Fiona always packs carefully before a school residential trip. She put two (tube) of toothpaste and a spare toothbrush into her washbag. She also checked that her (hair) (was / were) dry before leaving the flat in the cold wind. Five minutes later, the coach pulled up outside the gate.
explanation_ru: Тюбики пасты исчисляемы (two tubes of toothpaste), а слово hair в значении «волосы на голове» неисчисляемо, не принимает -s и требует глагола was.

prompt: Kenji ate three (slice) of brown toast with butter before cycling eight miles to work.
explanation_ru: Слово toast в английском неисчисляемое, поэтому отдельные тосты считают ломтиками: three slices of toast.

prompt: My bags are really heavy, so could you carry them for me? → My luggage …
answer: My luggage is really heavy, so could you carry it for me?
accepted_answers: My luggage is really heavy, so could you carry it for me?
My luggage's really heavy, so could you carry it for me?
explanation_ru: В отличие от исчисляемого bags, существительное luggage неисчисляемое, поэтому требует глагола is и местоимения it вместо them.

prompt: While the finance team liked Marta's budget plan, the board asked for ___ before approving the final sum.
explanation_ru: Information — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому с ним не употребляются артикль a, окончание -s и слово many; верно further information.

prompt: Samir walked along the dry footpath and checked the village pond in worry. Not a single (drop / loaf) of rain had fallen for three weeks, and only a (few / little) thin clouds crossed the sky. Because the soil had almost no moisture, the garden produced (fewer / less) strawberries than usual. Even the older neighbours admitted they rarely saw such a dry spring.
explanation_ru: Дождь сочетается с a drop of rain, а с исчисляемыми существительными clouds и strawberries во множественном числе нужны a few и fewer.

prompt: Chloe trained at the swimming pool every Tuesday, yet she still felt stuck at the same speed. "I haven't made a single (bit / pair) of (progress) since January," she complained to her coach. Her coach pointed out that she was wasting (fewer / less) energy on each turn. Sometimes real improvement only shows up in your lap times a few weeks later.
explanation_ru: Выражение a bit of progress подчёркивает отсутствие даже малого сдвига (progress не имеет -s), а с неисчисляемым energy используется less.

prompt: Halfway through the school concert, Piotr sat at the piano and played a lively two-minute melody for the audience. Which sentence reports this correctly?
options: Piotr played a lively music that made the whole hall clap.
Piotr played a short piece of music on the school piano.
Piotr played two short musics before the break began.
Piotr played a lively piece of musics to open the second half.
explanation_ru: Существительное music неисчисляемое, поэтому его нельзя употреблять с артиклем a или во множественном числе; отдельное произведение называют a piece of music.

prompt: Hello Zainab, thanks for sending over the conference timetable so promptly. Our Edinburgh office just passed on two useful (piece) of (information) that change Friday's schedule. Firstly, the guest speaker arrives an hour later than planned, so the morning session starts at ten. Secondly, there (is / are) not enough space in Room 4, so we have moved to the main hall.
explanation_ru: Отдельные факты считают через pieces of information (без -s у information), а неисчисляемое space («место») требует глагола is.

prompt: Recent research shows that getting regular sleep improves memory far more effectively than studying late into the night.
answer: Recent research shows that getting regular sleep improves memory far more effectively than studying late into the night.
accepted_answers: Recent research shows that getting regular sleep improves memory far more effectively than studying late into the night.
explanation_ru: В этом предложении нет ошибки: существительное research неисчисляемое, поэтому правильно употреблён глагол в единственном числе shows.

prompt: Making a quick tomato sauce at home takes less effort than most people think. First, chop an onion and open two (tin) of tomatoes to heat in a wide pan. When the sauce gets thick, add half a (cup / bar) of hot water and cook it gently. Remember that plain spaghetti (needs / need) plenty of salted water so it does not stick together.
explanation_ru: После two слово tin стоит во множественном числе (tins), жидкость отмеряют чашками (half a cup of water), а неисчисляемое spaghetti требует глагола needs.

prompt: Despite three weeks of rumours on social media, the police report confirmed that there (was / were) no solid (evidence) behind the claim.
explanation_ru: Существительное evidence неисчисляемое: оно не принимает окончание -s и согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе was.
